@section l35-45 | Unit 45 | Vocabulary practice · Unit 45 | 文意字彙・選擇題・配合題
@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。本單元請抽查：照片邊緣或反光處，個別字詞可能有誤。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: It is so cold in the room that I can't help but t______e.
= tremble
~詞義 tremble（v.）顫抖
~原文 It is so cold in the room that I can't help but tremble.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: After many hours of being questioned, the suspect finally c______sed that he had committed the crime.
= confessed
~詞義 confess（v.）坦承
~原文 After many hours of being questioned, the suspect finally confessed that he had committed the crime.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Jimmy c______ted his friend on winning first place in the international piano contest.
= congratulated
~詞義 congratulate（v.）恭喜
~原文 Jimmy congratulated his friend on winning first place in the international piano contest.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Sam was caught p______ping at his classmate's exam paper. In the end, he failed the course and had to take it again the next year.
= peeping
~詞義 peep（v.）偷窺
~原文 Sam was caught peeping at his classmate's exam paper. In the end, he failed the course and had to take it again the next year.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Many people consider p______ts bad creatures, but they are actually an essential part of the ecosystem.
= pests
~詞義 pest（n.）害蟲
~原文 Many people consider pests bad creatures, but they are actually an essential part of the ecosystem.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Nick wants to make sure that the watch he just bought is ______, not fake.
A: thoughtful
B: elementary
C: intermediate
D: authentic
= D
~詞義 authentic（adj.）真正的
~原文 Nick wants to make sure that the watch he just bought is authentic, not fake.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: I just finished reading Stephen Hawking's ______, which tells the entire life story of the scientist.
A: autobiography
B: discouragement
C: vegetarian
D: enforcement
= A
~詞義 autobiography（n.）自傳
~原文 I just finished reading Stephen Hawking's autobiography, which tells the entire life story of the scientist.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The camp leaders are training the kids to follow orders to teach them good ______.
A: nursery
B: discipline
C: hydrogen
D: telescope
= B
~詞義 discipline（n.）紀律
~原文 The camp leaders are training the kids to follow orders to teach them good discipline.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The failure didn't ______ him. Instead, he used it as motivation and came back stronger than ever.
A: reinforce
B: enforce
C: discourage
D: shiver
= C
~詞義 discourage（v.）使沮喪
~原文 The failure didn't discourage him. Instead, he used it as motivation and came back stronger than ever.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: After eating the fried chicken, my fingers were all ______.
A: greasy
B: timid
C: intellectual
D: agreeable
= A
~詞義 greasy（adj.）油膩的
~原文 After eating the fried chicken, my fingers were all greasy.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: hurricane
B: empire
C: hatred
D: perfume
E: telescopes
F: merits

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The coastal town prepared for the ______ by sealing up windows and storing emergency supplies.
= A
~詞義 hurricane（n.）颱風
~原文 The coastal town prepared for the hurricane by sealing up windows and storing emergency supplies.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ between the supporters of the two political parties is not something that can be solved by words alone.
= C
~詞義 hatred（n.）怨恨
~原文 The hatred between the supporters of the two political parties is not something that can be solved by words alone.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: When the boss evaluates his employees, he tries to look at their ______ instead of their flaws.
= F
~詞義 merit（n.）優點
~原文 When the boss evaluates his employees, he tries to look at their merits instead of their flaws.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: I really disliked the woman's ______ because its smell filled the entire room and made me feel sick.
= D
~詞義 perfume（n.）香水
~原文 I really disliked the woman's perfume because its smell filled the entire room and made me feel sick.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: The Persian ______ once ruled over most of the Middle East, Central Asia, and parts of Europe.
= B
~詞義 empire（n.）帝國
~原文 The Persian empire once ruled over most of the Middle East, Central Asia, and parts of Europe.

F: nuclear

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Marco Polo was a Venetian ______ who traveled along the ancient Silk Road.
= E
~詞義 merchant（n.）商人
~原文 Marco Polo was a Venetian merchant who traveled along the ancient Silk Road.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: Betty found it ______ of her neighbor to check in after hearing about her recent injury.
= C
~詞義 thoughtful（adj.）體貼的
~原文 Betty found it thoughtful of her neighbor to check in after hearing about her recent injury.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: After ten days of fighting, the rebels finally ______ to the government.
= A
~詞義 surrender（v.）投降
~原文 After ten days of fighting, the rebels finally surrendered to the government.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______ technology can produce low-carbon electricity, but it requires strict monitoring to prevent dangerous accidents.
= F
~詞義 nuclear（adj.）核能的
~原文 Nuclear technology can produce low-carbon electricity, but it requires strict monitoring to prevent dangerous accidents.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: Emma was so ______ that she wouldn't even speak to her classmates on her first day of school.
= B
~詞義 timid（adj.）膽小的
~原文 Emma was so timid that she wouldn't even speak to her classmates on her first day of school.
